name: Kiso 3867 (Hubble)
blurb: Kiso 3867, a metal-poor tadpole dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kiso3867-hubble
story: A small galaxy shaped like a tadpole, with its star formation crowded into a bright head. Astronomers think an inflow of fresh, nearly pristine gas set off this burst.

claims.text: Kiso 3867 is a tadpole galaxy, a metal-poor dwarf with a dominant star-forming region, observed by Hubble
Star formation is prominent in its head
Accretion of metal-poor gas is thought to have stimulated the star formation
Tadpole galaxies have a giant star-forming region at the end of an elongated body
